text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizen holding a valid ordinary passport, in accordance with the provisions of Document No. 12 [2020] issued by the Ministry of Education; 2. Generally aged between 18 and 25 years old; 3. In good physical and mental health, friendly toward China, with no history of drug abuse and no criminal record; 4. Applicants must be recent high school graduates or hold a high school diploma with good academic performance； 5. TOEFL≥80 or IELTS≥5.5 or Duolingo≥100 6. CSCA subjects requirements download here .
